body.zh: NDRRMA最新仍为10月2日11:37UTC人员调任，SitRep 2280无Bhotekoshi新伤亡。新华无新吉隆伤亡帖。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。堰塞湖已排空。口岸关闭。G216至9月20日仍管制。勿与中方相加。
body.en: NDRRMA latest remains 2 Oct 11:37 UTC staff note; SitRep 2280 has no new Bhotekoshi split. No new Xinhua Gyirong casualty post. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. Lake drained. Gate closed. G216 still controlled as of 20 Sep. Do not add CN.
